external.name: pi-lens
external.review: MIT. Self-contained Node; bundles @ast-grep/napi (native) + tree-sitter WASM + typescript. Auto-runs LSP/type/lint/structural + impact diagnostics on write/edit via hooks (no model tool required). Also registers optional LSP/AST agent tools — filter off in balanced to keep the visible surface minimal. 4.3.0 was evaluated for this release: it loads cleanly in a real pi 0.85.1 TUI, but it is a new major line (4.0.0 breaking changes), declares peer @earendil-works/pi-tui ^0.84.1 || ^0.85.0 and Node >=22.19, and its write/edit hooks cannot be exercised without a model provider, so 3.8.63 stays pinned for the beta.

external.name: pi-lean-ctx
external.review: Apache-2.0. OPT-IN, in no profile: it needs the external `lean-ctx` Rust CLI (`cargo install lean-ctx` or brew; not bundled, not in this package's supply chain) and, in its default additive mode, registers extra model-visible tools even when that CLI is absent (ctx_shell, ctx_read, ctx_ls, ctx_find, ctx_grep, lean_ctx, ctx_edit; checked against 3.10.5 in a real pi 0.85.1 TUI). Those tools are not inspected the way the built-in ones are: secret-guard matches the built-in names bash/write/edit, so ctx_shell and ctx_edit are outside its checks, and tool-firewall sees them only as unknown tools (policy default: ask) rather than as shell commands. Enable it only for trusted repositories and expect an approval prompt per call; it is installed by `install.mjs --all` only when its binary is on PATH. Installing 3.10.5 (verified to load and degrade gracefully without the CLI) replaces 3.8.18, whose review here wrongly said it adds no visible tools.

external.name: pi-readseek
external.review: MIT. @jarkkojs/readseek (native) + xxhash-wasm. Hash-anchored read/edit/grep + structural code maps + AST search — a lean file-I/O primitive for navigating large repos cheaply. Registers replacement tools (manual). 0.10.1 was evaluated and not adopted: its licence is now Apache-2.0 (this review covers the MIT 0.4.x line), the entry moved to dist/index.ts and it depends on @jarkkojs/readseek-api; 0.4.26 stays pinned until 0.10.x has been reviewed as a whole.
